title: Rewrite technique prompts: remove displacement math, elevate topology ops
description: The coons_cage and loop_cut technique prompts explicitly tell the agent to use set_position + field math for vertex displacement. The DSL_SYNTAX_REFERENCE Common Patterns also lists displacement as an idiom. This steers the agent toward a low-ceiling approach (float math on a cube cage ~72% similarity ceiling) instead of using topology operations (extrude, inset, loop_cut, coons_loop_cut, mirror). The agent has all these nodes in its catalog but the prompts tell it to use displacement as primary strategy. Also reframe reference_sample_points usage from coordinate positioning to shape understanding.
definition-of-done: 1. coons_cage prompt workflow uses loop_cut/inset_faces/extrude_mesh as primary steps, no mention of set_position + field math. 2. loop_cut prompt workflow uses extrude/inset, no displacement math. 3. Common Patterns line about Field computations removed from DSL_SYNTAX_REFERENCE. 4. reference_sample_points framing changed from coordinate positioning to shape understanding. 5. tag_geometry + mesh_compare_regions integrated as workflow step in coons_cage and loop_cut prompts.
testing-plan: 1. Run a voyage batch with coons_cage technique. 2. Check output DSL uses topology ops (extrude, inset, loop_cut) not set_position + field math. 3. Verify agent system prompt contains updated workflow steps. 4. Verify Common Patterns section no longer lists displacement idiom.
